# Radious

> A personal AI radio station. The listener hires one to three AI radio
> hosts, names them, chooses their voices and writes their personality
> in a single line. The hosts present a continuous radio show built
> around the listener's own music, reading their chosen news feeds in
> their chosen priority order, their city's weather, their calendar for
> the next 48 hours, and short explainers on topics they pick.

Radious is made in Tallinn, Estonia by a solo founder. It runs on the
web at app.radious.ai; a native iOS app is in development. As of August
2026 it is in a free founding beta with a limited number of seats, and
an open waitlist.

## What makes it different from other AI audio products

- **Inbound messages.** A listener can text the studio during a show.
  The message is read on air and answered as a two-host conversation,
  with the hosts responding to each other about it. No other consumer
  AI audio product is known to do this.
- **Live call-in.** A listener can start a live voice call into the
  studio mid-show and talk to a host, who can look up current facts
  during the call. This is an in-app voice session, not a telephone
  line.
- **Hosts are cast, not given.** Name, voice and personality are chosen
  by the listener. Spotify's AI DJ, Google's NotebookLM hosts and
  Amazon's Alexa briefings all supply a fixed presenter.
- **A show, not a briefing.** News, weather, calendar and interests are
  interleaved with music as a continuous programme rather than
  delivered as a digest.
- **31 languages**, including Estonian.

## Honest limitations

- News segments summarise the listener's own chosen feeds. Like any
  system of this kind they can get a detail wrong or misplace emphasis;
  the bulletin is a spoken headline scan, not a source of record.
- The hosts are synthetic. Radious does not claim they are human.
- Music comes from royalty-free third-party catalogues, or the
  listener's own local files. It is not a licensed commercial catalogue
  and does not include chart music.
- Access is currently gated: new listeners join a waitlist.
